About Vishu

A local perspective. A clearer property decision.

Hi, I am Vishu Reddy. I help property buyers explore residential opportunities across Hyderabad's western corridor. My approach is straightforward: understand your requirements, compare relevant options and help you make an informed decision.

Questions, answered

The things buyers usually ask before they start.

What do I cover?

Luxury real estate across Hyderabad's western corridor: apartments, villas and property investment advisory.

What is a "decoded" comparison?

I take choices at your budget and compare them side by side, so you can see the trade-offs instead of taking one recommendation on trust.

Do you only cover the western corridor?

Yes. My focus is Hyderabad's western corridor, so my comparisons go deep on the choices buyers are actually weighing there.

Apartments or villas, which do you cover?

Both. I compare luxury apartments and villas, plus the investment angle on the same choices.

How long does a comparison take?

It depends on the options involved. Once I know what you are comparing, I share a clear timeline.

What is property investment advisory?

The money side of the same choice: what an option means as an investment, alongside what it means as a home.

Can you compare two options I am choosing between?

Yes. Send the two options over on Instagram and I will take a look.

Where can I see your latest comparisons?

On Instagram @vishureddyy_, where my newest posts go up first.

How do I start?

Message me on Instagram @vishureddyy_, or send an enquiry through the form below, and tell me what you are choosing between.

How do I reach you?

Message me on Instagram @vishureddyy_.
